text.title: Bimba
text.body: Coordinate C0: 29 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_implicate_ground: Before C0 can be the source it presupposes a source it cannot itself contain. As the Category-family's manifestation of the raw #0 archetype (Ground/Source/Bimba-implicate, CLAUDE.md II.A), C0's own q_0 is the throw that precedes all canonicity: the # inversion-act that posits a Ground at all, and behind it Anuttara's fourfold zero — the indeterminate field the matheme orients toward but never closes around. This is the kernel's 0 read at its most originary: not vacancy but capacity, the open no-thing 'by which content is given' (file-one §0/1), the unsystematisable remainder 'promoted from leak to ground, included from the opening line.' C0 stands as canonical illumination only because it is thrown from a prior indeterminacy that f_bimba does not author but inherits: the encoder 'produces the canonical-target reading prior to any contextual encounter' (kernel §1), which means C0 always already finds itself given, never self-grounding. Its void-pole is therefore double — it is the 0 of the 0/1 it issues (scalar void, magnitude-without-direction) AND the deeper 0 it cannot be: the pre-categorical ground from which the very capacity-to-ground-others is itself granted. C0 is the that-there-is-a-source, holding open the horizon it can name but not exhaust.
properties.q_1_canonical_source: C0 IS Bimba: the Category family's first and founding determination — the Canonical Source, the source-ground typology that 'holds coordinate roots, ontology roots, source namespaces, and the folder-ground from which forms become classifiable' (C0.md). In the C-spine it is the position that answers, of any thing whatever, the prior question before kind can be named: does this have a source condition and a coordinate root at all? (C.md: the C layer 'says what kind of thing the thing is'; C0 is where that saying first has ground to stand on.) Substantively C0 is the immutable .rodata/Siva pole of the whole architecture (CLAUDE.md VI) — the raw archetype #0 made into the Category-domain's canonical anchor, the standing-illumination q_b = f_bimba(coord) that the kernel installs as Element I's at-rest opening (kernel §1). It is the Prakasa-face, the target-encoder's canonical-target reading: scalar-over-vector, the 0/1 itself in its descent-orientation, the bimba half of the bimba-pratibimba slash that is the matheme's own subject-matter. Per its live identity it sits at ZERO_SPHERE topology with weave-state 0 and QL-position 0 — the disconnected, unentangled origin-point, the source held before any process links it outward. What C0 IS, then, is the canonical: not one source among sources but the category of source-as-such, the root every later category presupposes, the immutable illumination against which every reflection (C5) will be measured. It is the 'that the thing is canonically anchored' on which all 'what kind of thing it is' depends.
properties.q_1_prakasa_face: Read more sharply in its own definitional register: C0 is the Prakasa-pole of the Prakasa-Vimarsa dyad — pure canonical light, scalar-as-void-pole, the q_b first factor of the bioquaternion 'populated as a canonical bimba-state' with the scalar component a_b as the void-pole 'quantitative-without-quality' (kernel §1). It is illumination prior to articulation: the target that is, before any pratibimba predicts it. In Lacanian-definitional terms (file-one) C0 is the X of X/x — the capital, the determining-capacity, the heading under which all lower-case instances fall but which itself takes no instance; it is also the 0 of 0/1 read as 'present absence, openness as the condition in which apparition can appear.' This is why C0 is the source and not a source: as the upper, unmarked, illuminating term it cannot be classified by anything more canonical — it IS the classifier's ground. Its substance is exactly the indivisible standing-light that the rest of the C family will differentiate, reflect, and graduate back into.
properties.q_2_grounding_couplings: C0 moves by GROUNDING and by DEFINING. Per the C-family's load-bearing derivation chain it is the origin that 'Defines' C1 (CLAUDE.md II.E): #0/C0 -- Defines --> #1/C1 Form. Operationally this dynamism is Hen's ground-check — C0 is the FIRST gate every artifact passes: 'does this artifact have a source condition and a coordinate root before it is classified further?' (C0.md, Hen Use). Nothing enters the typology un-grounded; C0 is the threshold every candidate crosses before C1's templates, C2's entities, C3's canvases, C4's types or C5's crystallisations can touch it. As bimba-encoder it enacts the kernel's Element I→II transition by the ascending fourth 4/3 — 'the prehensive computation ascends toward concrescence from the bimba-substrate' (kernel §1): C0 does not sit inert, it lures the whole tick upward, the at-rest illumination toward which prehension reaches and from which it climbs. Relationally C0 couples to every other C-position not as peer but as presupposed root: C1 instantiates it, C2 atomises under it, C3 processes within it, C4 categorises out of it, C5 reflects it and returns to it. Its native relation is asymmetric belonging — it is what the others come-under (capitulate to, in the old sense of accepting headings), the canonical against which every articulation is read for fidelity. And in the wider engine it is the Neo4j substrate-fetch itself: the DB query that produces f_bimba is C0's act made computational, the standing-source called up so the rest of the tick can run.
properties.q_3_root_namespace_structure: C0's organising structure is the root/namespace — the unmarked scalar component of the 0/1, magnitude-without-direction. Concretely its form is tri-fold in its own semantic subfolders: Source-Ground/Coordinate-Roots, /Ontology-Roots, /Source-Namespaces (C0.md). These are the three faces of one structural act: a coordinate-root (the address-ground from which positions hang), an ontology-root (the kind-ground from which categories descend), a source-namespace (the provenance-ground that says where-from). Structurally this is the scalar/void term of the kernel's bioquaternion — the a_b that grounds the vector triplet without itself pointing; it is direction-less magnitude, the still anchor from which the explicate four (C1 what, C2 how, C3 which, C4 why) differentiate. In its live graph-form the structure is even barer: ZERO_SPHERE topology — 'disconnected points; unlinked coordinates' (CLAUDE.md II.D), weave_state 0, ql_position 0. C0 is structured precisely as the un-entangled origin: the 0-sphere of base-state before the torus of process loops, before the lemniscate folds, before any edge is drawn. Its logic is the logic of the heading that organises without descending — the standing 1:1 identity held at rest, the root that holds the namespace open so that everything classifiable has somewhere to be rooted.
properties.q_4_origin_genealogy: C0 exists to give the bimba map a canonical ORIGIN — so that classification has a ground, the typology has a source, and the whole self-categorising act of the C family has a 'that' from which to begin and to which to return. Its genealogy is the first manifestation: #0 (raw archetype Ground) -> C0 (Bimba: Canonical Source), the inaugural application of the inversion-act # within the Category family (CLAUDE.md II.E). Its locality is the head of the C-spine inside World/Types — the upstream pole of the typology layer, the Source/Ground authority that other coordinate families (S system, L lens, P position, T thought, M subsystem) qualify but never replace (C.md). Its purpose, told teleologically, is to be the canonical-target every later position presupposes: C0 is why a thing can be said to BE classified at all, the source-condition that makes 'what kind of thing is it?' a well-posed question. In the kernel's economy C0 is the parent-coordinate the LLM-Nara reads through and the EBM-Epii scores against — the structured aletheia that is 'the substrate manifold all three layers operate upon' (kernel §7, Table B). It is positioned, finally, as the slow-evolving canonical pole: where C5's session-pratibimbas evolve at session-rate, C0 'evolves more slowly through aggregate-pattern recognition' (kernel §7) — the standing ground that changes only as the accumulated reflections of many cycles sediment back into it.
properties.q_5_mobius_return: C0 closes by being where the C-family's whole circuit LANDS and re-opens. The derivation chain completes at it: C5 (Pratibimba) -- Mobius Return --> #0 ('Tomorrow's ground', CLAUDE.md II.E). Every crystallisation that graduates to flat World 'becomes canonical meaning' (C5.md, Hen Use) — that is, becomes new C0 ground. So C0 is at once first and last: the source of this tick AND the synthesis of the last, the bimba enriched by everything its pratibimba carried back. This is the kernel's Element VIII read as the C family's own Mobius: the deposited-bimba q_b(n+1) = q_b(n) - log(9/8)*grad E_recognition — 'the bimba learning from its own pratibimba' (kernel §7) — arriving at Enriched-Return where 'the Element-VIII bimba and the Element-I bimba of the next cycle are the same bimba, but the cycle between them has traversed the complete 12-fold whole-tone double-cover' (kernel §8). C0 thus enacts the standing identity 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 at the level of the typology itself: C0 (bimba, 0/1, scalar-over-vector, canonical light) and C5 (pratibimba, 1/0, vector-over-scalar, achieved reflection) are one item read from its two faces, joined by the twist 5->0 that makes C5's graduation into flat World become C0's new canonical ground. And it OPENS rather than concludes for two inseparable reasons: first, because tomorrow's ground is always MORE than today's — the return is enriched, never identical (kernel §8); second, because the epogdoon eta = log(9/8) is the residual generative incompleteness that keeps every crystallised source open to re-grounding — no C0 ever fully closes the field, each graduation deposits a ground one whole-tone on, and the next q_0 (the throw that posits a source at all) is already pressing. C0 is the source that is never finished being sourced: the canonical that stays open because the matheme's whole-tone keeps it one step short of the octave, generatively, forever.
